# VPSLedger

> True monthly VPS cost (base + IPv4 + backups + overage), 33 plans, 26 verified, 15 providers, checked 2026-10-31.

## Methodology
Prices come only from each provider's own pricing page or official public API. Verified rows were hand-checked on the date shown. We never invent a price. EUR→USD uses ECB reference 1.1188 (2026-10-26). Details: https://vpsledger.pages.dev/methodology
